# Rating: `jl-rating`

A row of stars to give a score, or to show one.

- Class `JlRating`, an atom: `import { JlRating } from '@syware/jlib';`
- On the site: https://bioleyl.github.io/jlib/components/rating

A score out of a few stars (or hearts, or any icon). A click sets it, and a click on the score already
given clears it; hovering shows the score a click would give. From the keyboard it is a slider: the arrows add or
take one, Home and End go to the ends, a digit sets that many.

Use readonly to show a score people cannot change, such as an average. The filled icons take the accent colour;
set --color on the element for another.

## Use

```ts
import { JlRating } from '@syware/jlib';
```

```tsx
<JlRating label="Your rating" value={3} />
```

```html
<jl-rating label="Your rating" value="3"></jl-rating>
```

## Properties

Inputs: a JSX prop sets one, code calls `.set(value)` and `.get()`, HTML writes the attribute (lists and objects as JSON).

- `value` (attribute `value`): `number`, default `0`. The score; 0 for none.
- `max` (attribute `max`): `number`, default `5`. How many icons the scale has (up to 10).
- `icon` (attribute `icon`): `string`, default `'star'`. The icon drawn for each step.
- `size` (attribute `size`): `'sm' | 'md' | 'lg'`, default `'md'`. The icons: 16, 20 or 26 pixels.
- `readonly` (attribute `readonly`): `boolean`, default `false`. Shows the score without letting people change it.
- `label` (attribute `label`): `string`, default `''`. The name screen readers give the scale. Empty: jlib's own text, in the language shown.
- `name` (attribute `name`): `string`, default `''`. The field's name in the form's data.
- `required` (attribute `required`): `boolean`, default `false`. The form cannot be submitted without a score.
- `disabled` (attribute `disabled`): `boolean`, default `false`. Cannot be changed or focused.
- `invalid` (attribute `invalid`): `boolean`, default `false`. The empty icons in the danger colour, for an error the page found.

## Events

In JSX, the `on…` prop, its handler given the detail; in code, `events.register(name, (detail) => …)`. They do not bubble.

- `change` (`onChange` in JSX), detail `number`: People gave a score, or cleared it (0).

## Methods

- `focus(options?: FocusOptions): void`: Focuses the scale.
- `checkValidity(): boolean`: Whether a required rating has a score.

## Styling

- `--color` (custom property): The colour of the filled icons; the accent by default.
- `--empty` (custom property): The colour of the empty icons.
- `base` (part, `::part(base)`): The row of icons (the slider).

## Examples

HTML as the site renders it, with its layout classes (`row`, `stack`, `narrow`, `muted`), which are not jlib's: a view writes the same components by class in JSX. A script's `root` is the example's element.

### Sizes

```html
<div class="stack">
  <jl-rating size="sm" value="2" label="Small"></jl-rating>
  <jl-rating value="3" label="Medium"></jl-rating>
  <jl-rating size="lg" value="4" label="Large"></jl-rating>
</div>
```

### Read only

A score to read, not to give: the icons do not react.

```html
<div class="row">
  <jl-rating value="4" readonly label="Average rating"></jl-rating>
  <span class="muted">4.2 out of 5 · 128 reviews</span>
</div>
```

### Other icons and scales

Any icon, any length of scale, any colour through --color.

```html
<div class="stack">
  <jl-rating icon="heart" value="3" label="Love it" style="--color: var(--jl-danger)"></jl-rating>
  <jl-rating icon="zap" max="10" value="7" size="sm" label="Energy"></jl-rating>
</div>
```

### Listening

The word follows change; press the chosen star again to clear it.

```html
<div class="row">
  <jl-rating class="demo-review" value="3" label="Your review"></jl-rating>
  <span class="muted demo-review-out">Good</span>
</div>
```

```js
const words = ['No rating', 'Poor', 'Fair', 'Good', 'Very good', 'Excellent'];
const rating = root.querySelector('.demo-review');
const out = root.querySelector('.demo-review-out');
rating.events.register('change', (value) => {
  out.textContent = words[value];
});
```

### States

```html
<div class="row">
  <jl-rating value="2" disabled label="Disabled"></jl-rating>
  <jl-rating value="0" invalid required label="Required"></jl-rating>
</div>
```
